input.transcript: MAYA: We spend maybe two hours a day on DMs... honestly booking is the whole problem. NEEL: What have you tried? MAYA: Calendly felt wrong for classes, and Mindbody was way too much money, like three hundred a month. We could do maybe half that if it actually worked. NEEL: Timeline? MAYA: Before summer schedule goes up, so six weeks maybe. Next step, send me something in writing.

output.situation: Harbor Pilates runs all class booking through Instagram DMs, costing around two hours per day of founder time. Previous tools were rejected: generic scheduling felt wrong for classes and Mindbody was too expensive.
goals: Move class booking out of DMs into a system that fits small-group classes
Free up the daily DM triage time
constraints: Live before the summer schedule, roughly six weeks
Mindbody-level pricing (about $300/month) was rejected as too expensive
budget_signals: Quote: Mindbody was 'way too much money, like three hundred a month. We could do maybe half that if it actually worked'
next_steps: Send a written proposal (agreed on the call)
notable_quotes: Honestly booking is the whole problem.
